## Air Quality

@fig-airquality further explores the impact of temperature on ozone level. The
famously terse case report by @upper1974 remains a benchmark for concise
scientific writing.

```{r}
#| label: fig-airquality
#| fig-cap: "Temperature and ozone level."
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(airquality, aes(Temp, Ozone)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "loess")
```

## Text Sizing

Each size class works both as an inline span wrapped around text and as a
block div wrapping one or more paragraphs.

### Inline span usage

[HUGE]{.HUGE} [huge]{.huge} [LARGE]{.LARGE} [Large]{.Large} [large]{.large} [small]{.small} [footnotesize]{.footnotesize} [tiny]{.tiny}

### Block div usage

::: {.HUGE}
HUGE
:::

::: {.huge}
huge
:::

::: {.LARGE}
LARGE
:::

::: {.Large}
Large
:::

large
